caption:
Nobody shares a form. Give your contest a 30-second score to beat. Comment "GAME" if your next marketing campaign needs one.

Your contest right now: name, email, prize... and silence.

3 gamification mechanics that make a brand activation shareable:

1. A timer: 30 seconds, one simple goal.
2. A score: instant feedback on every move, so people want one more try.
3. A leaderboard: a rank is worth bragging about.

Then the share writes itself: "I scored 900. Beat me." (scores and names on screen are an example)

A form collects emails. A game spreads.
